content.title: Apple Launches Job Listing for AI Agent Engineer
content.caption: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent, aiming to compete with other AI assistants like Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots, Anthropic's Duet, and Google's Tasks.

slides.heading: Apple Launches Job Listing for AI Agent Engineer
slides.text: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent, aiming to compete with other AI assistants like Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots, Anthropic's Duet, and Google's Tasks.

slides.heading: What Apple is Doing
slides.text: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
slides.text: Apple is planning to give Siri more agentic capabilities, as a report from Bloomberg suggests the company could add the ability to rotate and crop images in Photos, or organize Safari tabs.
